name: comp-294

frames.best_why: The card is shown largest, with the refresh badge, version line, description, both buttons and close cross clear.

tagline: A refresh badge and two buttons announce that a new version is ready.
summary: A software update notification. A round badge with a circular refresh arrow leads a version headline and short explanation, with a filled Install button, a link-style Later and a close cross.
appearance: A bordered card with a soft shadow holds a circular outlined badge containing two curved arrows. Beside it a bold version sentence and two muted lines of release notes, then a light Install button, an underlined Later, and a grey X at the top right.
behaviour: Hovering shades the Install button and the close cross and underlines Later, but no click is wired: the card never closes and no update starts.
demo_content: The line "Version 1.4 is now available!" with a note about bug fixes and performance improvements.
use_when: A web app should nudge people toward a new version without blocking their work.
avoid_when: Every control is decorative: the card cannot be closed, installed or deferred.
customise: Version line, description and both button labels are written in the file; there are no props and the width cap is fixed in a class.
weight_why: A card with one icon and three simple buttons; only hover fades run.

a11y.note: The close button is named and all controls take focus, but none of them has an action attached.

issues: Install, Later and the close cross have no handlers, so pressing any of them does nothing.
polish_why: Clear hierarchy and tidy spacing; the buttons are the only unfinished part.
search_phrases: update prompt with install and later
remind me to update the app
software update box in the corner
two choice buttons on an alert
title: App Update Notification
